STEP 1 - Scene: This is a buffet-style tasting plate. It holds a roast chicken leg (drumstick plus part of the thigh), a fresh spring roll with shrimp, a breaded fried shrimp, a cucumber piece, and a sesame/granola bar with a chocolate drizzle.

STEP 2 - Vessel: The plate has a ribbed rim and looks like a dinner plate about 27 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Roast chicken leg (with skin and bone)
- Rice-paper spring roll with shrimp
- Breaded fried shrimp
- Cucumber piece
- Sesame bar with chocolate drizzle

STEP 4 - Area coverage (total ≈ 22% of the plate):

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken | 9% | 51 cm² |
| Spring roll | 3.5% | 20 cm² |
| Fried shrimp | 3% | 17 cm² |
| Cucumber | 2.5% | 14 cm² |
| Sesame bar | 4% | 23 cm² |

STEPS 5–7 - Volume, weight and energy:

| Item | Volume | Density | Weight | Energy density | Energy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chicken (bone included) | 51 cm² × 3 cm = 153 ml | 0.8 | 122 g | ~190 kcal/100 g (edible part, bone discounted) | 232 kcal |
| Spring roll | 20 cm² × 2.5 cm = 50 ml | 0.9 | 45 g | 110 kcal/100 g | 50 kcal |
| Fried shrimp | 17 cm² × 2.5 cm = 42 ml | 0.8 | 34 g | 250 kcal/100 g | 85 kcal |
| Cucumber | 14 cm² × 2 cm = 28 ml | 0.6 | 17 g | 15 kcal/100 g | 3 kcal |
| Sesame bar | 23 cm² × 1.5 cm = 35 ml | 0.8 | 28 g | 480 kcal/100 g | 134 kcal |

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 246 g and about 504 kcal. That is plausible for a small tasting plate with these five pieces.
